Done when: the report downloads as XML, validates against its XSD and prints through XSLT.

Done when: rate limits, CAPTCHA, access rules for every role, licence limits, bot flags, audit log and alerts work.

Done when: a student edits with no internet, reconnects, and the changes appear for the group.

Done when: Ansible sets up a fresh VPS with k3s and the Postman collection runs in CI.

Done when: the CAPTCHA shows, a 429 gives a friendly wait message, and bot flags appear in the lecturer view.
